description: This file defines a Swift actor 'GatewayNodeSession' responsible for managing WebSocket-based communication with a gateway server. It includes functions for connection management, handling events and push messages, invoking commands with timeouts, and URL normalization. The file also defines auxiliary data structures and utility functions related to session handling.

classes.name: GatewayNodeSession
classes.description: An actor managing WebSocket session with a gateway, handling connection, disconnection, events, and remote procedure calls.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeout
methods.description: Executes a request with a specified timeout, ensuring timeout response is sent if the operation takes too long.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection with the given parameters and sets up handlers for session lifecycle events.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Shuts down the current session and resets connection state.

methods.name: refreshNodeCanvasCapability
methods.description: Requests and updates the node's canvas capability, updating the scoped URL accordingly.
